standard-dialogue.npc: Hello there...thanks for helping out Trufitus commune with the gods Bwana. We've been able to return to the village thanks to your help.

steps.npc: Oh, I just walk around a bit...I have to help my Mum and Dad a lot though because I'm still only young. I'd love to visit the mainland one day though and get out of this boring village.

options.text: Is there anything interesting to do here?

steps.npc: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.

options.text: I've been doing some work around the village.

steps.player: I've been doing some work around the village.

steps.text: If the player can claim trading sticks from Layleen:

steps.npc: Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.

steps.text: You get [amount] trading sticks. You are left with [amount]% favour.
If the player can't claim trading sticks from Layleen:

steps.npc: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?

receiving-trading-sticks.npc: Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.

receiving-trading-sticks.text: You get [some amount of] trading sticks. You are left with [some percentage]% favour.

steps.npc: Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!

steps.player: What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.

steps.npc: Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
